## PersonalDataCenter v0.1.4

The app can now update itself. Until this release the only way to get a new version was to notice one on GitHub and download it by hand; 设置 → 关于与更新 now checks the latest release, shows its notes, downloads the NSIS installer, verifies it against the published SHA-256 and installs it in place. The check asks the GitHub REST API first and falls back to plain release pages when the API is rate-limited or unreachable, so a shared egress address cannot stop it. Backup behaviour, the configuration file and the IndexedDB record are untouched — this is a drop-in replacement for v0.1.3.

## New

### 关于与更新

A second page under 设置, reachable from the menu, from the new 关于与更新 menu item, and from a 发现新版本 notification on startup when a newer release exists.

- It shows the running version, the release notes of the newer one, its published date and size, and two buttons: 下载并安装 and 在 GitHub 查看.
- **检查更新** can be pressed at any time; the startup check is separate and throttled (below).
- The startup result is cached in the main process, so opening the page later shows the update that was already found instead of asking GitHub again.

### The check has two paths, and the fallback is not a silent one

The primary path is `api.github.com/repos/Jaspersol/personal-data-center/releases/latest`: one JSON document gives the tag, the notes, the published date, the installer's name and size, and the address of its checksum.

The fallback is plain `github.com`, and it exists because the REST API allows only 60 calls an hour per address — a shared connection regularly spends them, and a check that answers 403 is not an answer. On any failure of the primary, the fallback reads the version tag out of the `releases/latest` redirect and the installer name plus SHA-256 out of the release's `SHA256SUMS.txt`. That path never touches `api.github.com`, so it costs none of the quota.

A fallback is logged (`检查更新主路径失败，切换备用方案: …`) rather than passing for a normal check, and when both paths fail the error names both, with the fallback's message in front.

### Installing is verified at every step

- **Checksums are mandatory.** The digest comes from the release's `<setup>.exe.sha256` or, failing that, from `SHA256SUMS.txt`. With neither, 下载并安装 stays disabled and the page says why — the app will not run an installer it cannot verify.
- **Downloads accept GitHub hosts only.** Every redirect hop is validated against an allowlist before it is followed, and the response's body is cancelled before a rejected hop is abandoned, so a refused redirect cannot leave a connection half-open.
- **The file is checked as it arrives.** Size cap of 512 MB, `MZ` header, and the SHA-256 computed while streaming; a mismatch deletes the file and fails the install.
- **The installer is started, not waited on.** It runs silently (`/S --force-run --updated`), the app exits 400 ms later, and the installer reopens it.
- **Authenticode is deliberately not verified.** The hash and the installer come from the same release, so it proves integrity, not authorship. This is recorded in the code as an open item, not an oversight.

### Startup checks and the switch

- One check at startup, at most once every 6 hours, recorded as a timestamp in `update-settings.json` under `userData`.
- The switch (启动时自动检查更新) sits on the same page and persists there; it only ever *notifies* — nothing is downloaded without pressing 下载并安装.
- A startup check never interrupts: a failure is logged and forgotten, and the app opens normally.

### A release now publishes three assets

`.github/workflows/release.yml` builds the Windows installer on a `v*` tag and publishes `PersonalDataCenter-<version>-setup.exe`, the portable build, `<setup>.exe.sha256` (for the API path) and `SHA256SUMS.txt` (for the fallback). Both checksum files are written with LF endings and no BOM, because the fallback parser splits on `\n` and a trailing `\r` would stick to the installer name.

## Downloads

| File | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `PersonalDataCenter-0.1.4-setup.exe` | NSIS installer, x64, per-user |
| `PersonalDataCenter-0.1.4-portable.exe` | Single portable executable, no install |

## Notes

- Windows only: the compressors are `rar` (WinRAR on `PATH`) for Windows paths and `wsl.exe` + `tar` for paths inside a WSL distribution. Paths written as `/mnt/c/...`, `/home/...` or `\\wsl.localhost\...` are resolved to the right side automatically.
- An existing `backup.config.json` in `userData` is still honoured, and the IndexedDB record is unchanged. The new `update-settings.json` sits beside them and holds only the auto-check switch and the last check time.
- The portable build checks and downloads the same way, but the file it installs is the *setup* build: running it leaves an installed copy, which is where updates go from then on.
- Stack: Electron 41 · Vue 3 · vue-router · Element Plus · Vite 8 · IndexedDB · electron-builder.
